description: 对话练习：Story time + Cartoon time 完整内容，角色扮演跟读

sections.title: Story time — Changes in our lives

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Six years ago, Mike could read and draw, but he could not write.
lines.chinese: 六年前，Mike会读和画，但他不会写。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Now he can do many things.
lines.chinese: 现在他会做很多事情。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Thirty years ago, Grandpa listened to the radio and read newspapers for news.
lines.chinese: 三十年前，爷爷听收音机、看报纸来获取新闻。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Now he can read and watch news on the Internet. He reads e-books too.
lines.chinese: 现在他可以在互联网上阅读和观看新闻。他也看电子书。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Twenty years ago, Grandma wrote letters to her friends.
lines.chinese: 二十年前，奶奶给她的朋友们写信。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: She made friends at school.
lines.chinese: 她在学校交朋友。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Now she writes emails to her e-friends.
lines.chinese: 现在她给她的网友们写电子邮件。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: She does shopping on the Internet.
lines.chinese: 她在互联网上购物。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Twenty years ago, Dad used the telephone at home and in the office to call people.
lines.chinese: 二十年前，爸爸在家和办公室用电话给人们打电话。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Now he has a mobile phone and he can call people anywhere.
lines.chinese: 现在他有一部手机，他可以在任何地方给人们打电话。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Twenty years ago, Mum went to shops and paid in cash.
lines.chinese: 二十年前，妈妈去商店购物，付现金。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Now she often shops online and pays on her smartphone.
lines.chinese: 现在她经常在网上购物，用智能手机支付。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Many things change over time. People change, places change and our life changes too.
lines.chinese: 许多事情随着时间推移而改变。人在变，地方在变，我们的生活也在变。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Two weeks ago, Bobby's parents bought a robot from a shop.
lines.chinese: 两周前，Bobby的父母从商店买了一个机器人。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: The robot cooked a big dinner. Bobby, Tina and their parents liked the food very much.
lines.chinese: 机器人做了一顿丰盛的晚餐。Bobby、Tina和他们的父母都非常喜欢这些食物。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Look at this robot! He's very smart!
lines.chinese: 看这个机器人！他非常聪明！

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: He can do many things!
lines.chinese: 他会做很多事情！

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: The robot played chess with Bobby. He won every time.
lines.chinese: 机器人和Bobby下国际象棋。他每次都赢。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Our robot is cooking dinner for us. He'll give us a surprise.
lines.chinese: 我们的机器人正在给我们做晚餐。他会给我们一个惊喜。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: I can't wait!
lines.chinese: 我等不及了！

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: One day, Bobby, Tina and their parents went to the park.
lines.chinese: 有一天，Bobby、Tina和他们的父母去了公园。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: They came back late.
lines.chinese: 他们回来得很晚。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Where's our dinner? Where's the robot?
lines.chinese: 我们的晚餐在哪里？机器人在哪里？

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: What happened?
lines.chinese: 发生了什么事？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Oh no! What's wrong with the robot?
lines.chinese: 哦不！机器人怎么了？

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: The robot was on the floor. It didn't work.
lines.chinese: 机器人躺在地板上。它不工作了。
